verdict.rationale: DBOS itself is a library with no API surface to spec, but its Conductor control-plane API is explicitly OpenAPI-described (dbos-docs-17) and a runtime probe confirmed a live OpenAPI 3.1 JSON spec at https://cloud.dbos.dev/conductor/v2/openapi.json (dbos-probe-rt-4), while the main docs domain has no discoverable openapi.json (dbos-probe-2). missing for 10: a single consolidated/discoverable OpenAPI spec for the whole product (not just Conductor), and independent/community confirmation of using it.
